heapOrArchives.title: The Shell Traders
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

heapOrArchives.rulesText: Provides +2 MU and +2 hand size. Put [2] from the bank on Cortical Cybermodem when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs. If you use any of these bits, replace them from the bank at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.
